burst_pause_storage_note: Calibration/evaluation directories are inherited storage labels; all50 inputs form the reported fixed single-unit comparison cohort.
network_burst_note: The general-detection and network-target tasks use the SAME60 evaluation inputs, not separate cohorts.
network_null_note: 21 paired backgrounds and independently timed regional inputs; no planted network targets; chance alignment remains possible. Header-only network_ground_truth files are intentional.
network_shift_note: Two derived desynchronization realizations per evaluation input; no event-recovery truth assigned to shifted copies. Offset and source-input hashes are in offset_manifest.csv.
sensitivity_note: Window/bin and runtime studies reuse evaluation inputs. Duration reporting uses fixed detected memberships, not newly generated inputs.
simulator_group_labels: Anatomical-looking electrode names are simulated compatibility labels; public_region in channel maps maps them to R1-R5.
